note: Security incident feedback; includes a conflicting severity pair.

corrections.author: sec.eng@example.com
corrections.subject: wrong gateway version
corrections.body: The affected service was on auth-gateway 3.4.0, not 3.5.2. Portals on 3.5.2 were not hit.

corrections.author: soc_reviewer
corrections.subject: duration + blank actions
corrections.body: Attack window was six hours (23:05 to 05:10 UTC), and Corrective Actions is blank.

corrections.author: ciso@example.com
corrections.subject: severity too low
corrections.body: 1,240 unauthorized attempts against production is High, not Informational.

corrections.author: soc_reviewer
corrections.subject: severity assessment
corrections.body: No confirmed takeovers, so Medium per the matrix, not High.

corrections.author: soc_reviewer
corrections.subject: wrong figure
corrections.body: The Timeline figure reference is wrong; it should be the login-volume timeline.
